info.title: Partner API
info.description:
## Overview

API for partner authentication, campaign management, agency settings, and statistics.
Designed to be consumed by human developers and AI agents alike.

**Base URL**

| Environment | URL |
|-------------|-----|
| Staging     | https://staging.streamstack.cc |
| Production  | https://streamstack.cc |

**Required headers for every request**

```
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer {token}   ← all endpoints except POST /api/v1/auth/partner
```

---

## Authentication

**Step 1 — obtain a token**

```http
POST /api/v1/auth/partner
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "login": "partner@example.com",
  "password": "your-password"
}
```

**Response**

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "token": "1|abc123xyz456..."
}
```

Use the value of `token` as a Bearer token in all subsequent requests:

```
Authorization: Bearer 1|abc123xyz456...
```

---

## Campaign workflow (Brand Awareness example)

Creating a campaign requires three steps: **Campaign → Ad Set → Ad**.
Each level returns a `slug` which is the identifier for the next step.

### Step 1 — resolve reference IDs

Before creating a campaign you need valid IDs for required fields.
Call these endpoints once and cache the results:

| What you need | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| `category` (campaign category ID) | `GET /api/v1/dictionary/campaigns/categories` |
| `time_zone` (time zone ID) | `GET /api/v1/dictionary/time-zones` |
| `holding`, `advertiser` (partner-specific) | `GET /api/v1/partner/campaigns/brand_awareness/dictionaries` |
| `format` (ad set format ID) | `GET /api/v1/dictionary/campaigns/formats` |

### Step 2 — create a Campaign

```http
POST /api/v1/partner/campaigns/brand_awareness/create
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "title": "Summer Gaming Campaign",
  "description": "Brand awareness for gaming product launch",
  "category": 3,
  "start": "2024-06-01T00:00:00Z",
  "holding": 1,
  "advertiser": 5,
  "time_zone": 1
}
```

**Response** — extract `campaign.slug` for the next step:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "campaign": {
    "slug": "BA-CMP-1741358023",
    "title": "Summer Gaming Campaign",
    ...
  }
}
```

### Step 3 — create an Ad Set

```http
POST /api/v1/partner/campaigns/brand_awareness/ad-set/create
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "slug": "BA-CMP-1741358023",
  "title": "Twitch Banner Placement",
  "platform": "twitch",
  "format": "video_overlay",
  "cpm": 5.00,
  "budget": 500.00
}
```

**Response** — extract `ad_set.slug` for the next step:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "ad_set": {
    "slug": "BA-GRP-1741358023",
    ...
  }
}
```

### Step 4 — create an Ad (upload creative)

```http
POST /api/v1/partner/campaigns/brand_awareness/ad/create
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

slug=BA-CMP-1741358023
adset_slug=BA-GRP-1741358023
title=Banner Creative
click_url=https://example.com/landing
media=@banner.png
```

---

## Getting daily statistics

Use the `slug` from the campaign and specify the date range in `YYYY-MM-DD` format:

```http
GET /api/v1/statistic/campaigns/brand-awareness/campaigns/{slug}/{from}/{to}
Authorization: Bearer {token}

Example:
GET /api/v1/statistic/campaigns/brand-awareness/campaigns/BA-CMP-1741358023/2024-06-01/2024-06-30
```

**Response** — daily breakdown of impressions, clicks, CTR, and reach:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "statistic": [
    {
      "date": "2024-06-01",
      "impressions": 12400,
      "clicks": 186,
      "ctr": 1.5,
      "reach": 9800
    }
  ]
}
```

For CSV/XLSX export append `/download` or `/xls/download` to the same URL.

---

## Slug format reference

| Campaign type | Campaign slug | Ad Set slug |
|---|---|---|
| Brand Awareness | `BA-CMP-{timestamp}` | `BA-GRP-{timestamp}` |
| Performance | `PF-CMP-{timestamp}` | `PF-GRP-{timestamp}` |
| Preroll | `VOD-CMP-{timestamp}` | `VOD-GRP-{timestamp}` |
| Extension | `EXT-CMP-{timestamp}` | `EXT-GRP-{timestamp}` |

---

## Error responses

All errors follow a consistent shape:

```json
{
  "status": false,
  "messages": [
    { "type": "error", "message": "Validation failed" }
  ]
}
```

| HTTP code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `401` | Missing or invalid Bearer token |
| `422` | Validation error (field-level details in `messages`) |
| `500` | Server error |
